subject.title: refactor: inline hasContentBearingPollCreationParam into its only caller

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this behavior-neutral poll-helper cleanup after the contributor rebases it and removes the orphaned helper?
rationale: The remaining defect is mechanical, but deciding whether this unsolicited refactor is worth reconciling with newer poll work is a maintainer ownership choice.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Ask for a current-main rebase that removes the orphaned helper, then review the resulting minimal cleanup and focused poll tests.

options.title: Decline incidental cleanup
options.body: Close the PR without merging if the small indirection reduction is not worth rebasing against active poll-path changes.
